comment: The toolchains of crudui that no other file declares. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Go, uv and Python, alint for make layout-check, ruff and vulture for make lint-python, golangci-lint and deadcode for make lint-go, cargo-audit for make dependency-review, and Composer, which installs PHPCS and PHPStan of config/php-lint for make lint-php) and mise.lock locks them. PHP is verified at the declared release. pythonBackend is the one declaration of the build backend of the Python wheels, which install-tools installs and the release builds the wheels with (kit K166, C14.44). The exception keeps packages/svelte on TypeScript 6.

exceptions.reason: svelte-check 4.7.7 and @sveltejs/package 3.0.1, which type-check and package the Svelte components, require the TypeScript 6 API: their peer ranges are ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0 and ^6.0.0, and TypeScript 7 has no such API.
exceptions.retry: Retry TypeScript 7.0.2 in packages/svelte when svelte-check and @sveltejs/package admit TypeScript 7 in their peer ranges.
